_note:
Batch 18 — Beauty & Self-Care. Researched from each business's own website and public listings, not scraped from Google: Google's terms don't permit it and the Places integration exists for that job. Every listing is a real Perth business; details left empty are details I could not verify, never guesses. Blurbs are written for Oria Haven, not copied. rating 0 / reviews 0 / status unclaimed, as with every seeded batch.

Deliberately absent: cosmetic injectables, anti-wrinkle injections and dermal fillers. Botulinum toxin is a Schedule 4 prescription-only medicine in Australia and advertising prescription-only medicines to the public is prohibited under the Therapeutic Goods Act — which is why Perth clinics say 'anti-wrinkle injections' rather than the brand name. Santé Skin does offer injectables; its listing describes the rest of what it does. Nothing here names a skin condition or promises a result.

listings.name: Oxford Beauty Clinic
listings.blurb: A long-standing Leederville salon working with the Guinot Hydradermie and O Cosmedics ranges, alongside lash and brow tinting and body waxing. Thursday evenings run late, and some Saturdays are available by appointment.
listings._source: oxfordbeautyclinic.com.au — address, phone, extended Thursday hours, alternate Saturdays, Guinot and O Cosmedics ranges, lash/brow tinting and waxing all confirmed. No public email address found.

listings.name: Beauté Boudoir
listings.address: Unit 1/102 Clifton Crescent, Mount Lawley WA 6050
listings.blurb: A small skin clinic and beauty therapy room tucked off Clifton Crescent in Mount Lawley, working one client at a time rather than running a floor of chairs.
listings._source: beauteboudoir.com.au contact page — unit address, mobile and email confirmed. Described on its own site as a skin clinic and beauty therapy practice; specific treatment list not itemised here, so services are kept general.

listings.name: Unique Beauty & Style
listings.blurb: A Beaufort Street salon covering beauty and hair in one place, from nails and makeup through to facial treatments, brow and lash tinting. Open late on Thursdays.
listings._source: uniquebeautystyle.com and its Timely booking page — Beaufort Street address, mobile, and Tue–Sat hours with a late Thursday confirmed. Nail, makeup, facial and tinting services listed on its own service pages. Public email not published in plain text.

listings.name: Little Nail Co.
listings.blurb: A small Claremont studio working only in gel and natural nails — manicures and overlays rather than acrylic extensions, one chair at a time.
listings._source: littlenailco.com.au — Railway Street address, mobile and email confirmed. Describes itself as a boutique gel and natural nail studio specialising in gel manicures and overlays. Opening hours not published on the site.

listings.name: Glamour Nail Bar — Subiaco
listings.blurb: Custom manicures, pedicures and nail art at the Subiaco branch of a two-salon Perth business, which also runs its own nail training courses.
listings._source: glamournailbar.com.au — Subiaco phone, shared email, and the manicure/pedicure/nail-art/training offer confirmed. The site names its Subiaco and Cockburn salons but does not publish street addresses, so address is left empty rather than guessed. Cockburn branch not listed separately for the same reason.

listings.name: Skinhaus Perth
listings.blurb: A single-room skin studio in Trigg working through consultations rather than a set menu — peels, microneedling, dermaplaning, IPL and LED, booked one at a time.
listings._source: skinhausperth.com.au — treatment list taken from its own treatments page; address and email from its contact page. Runs as a home studio in Trigg. No public phone number published; no injectables offered.

listings.name: Santé Skin Boutique
listings.blurb: A skin boutique on South Terrace offering peels, skin needling and LED light therapy. Late on Thursdays, shorter hours Friday and Saturday, closed Mondays.
listings._source: santeskin.au — South Terrace address, email and full opening hours confirmed. The clinic also offers cosmetic injectables; those are deliberately not listed, since advertising prescription-only medicines to the public is prohibited under the Therapeutic Goods Act. No public phone number published.

listings.name: Perth Lash Extensions — North Perth
listings.address: Shop 4/265 Walcott Street, North Perth WA 6006
listings.blurb: A Walcott Street lash salon that also covers brows, skin and spray tanning, part of a small Perth group with a second room closer to the city.
listings._source: perthlashextensions.com.au North Perth salon page — Walcott Street address, mobile and the lash/skin/brow/spray-tan offer confirmed. The City West salon is a separate location and is not listed here; its page gives no street address.

listings.name: Brazilian Butterfly Fremantle
listings.blurb: The Fremantle salon of a national waxing chain, on High Street. Body and facial waxing, brows, and the Brazilian work the name is built on.
listings._source: brazilianbutterfly.com Fremantle salon page — High Street address, phone and the waxing service list confirmed. Franchise location; no salon-specific email published.

listings.name: Pamper Face and Body
listings.blurb: A home salon on the corner of Pier and Penshurst in East Fremantle, covering facials, waxing, massage and nails without the shopfront overheads.
listings._source: pamperfaceandbody.com.au — Pier Street address (corner of Penshurst) and the facials/waxing/massage/manicure/pedicure list confirmed on its own site. Contact is via its booking form; no phone or email published in plain text.

listings.name: A Touch of Sass
listings.blurb: An East Fremantle salon weighted towards skin — advanced facials and peels — with lash, brow and waxing work alongside.
listings._source: atouchofsass.com.au — suburb and the advanced facials, peels, lash, brow and waxing offer confirmed from its own site. Street address, phone and email are not published on the pages reached; left empty rather than guessed, and worth one manual check before publishing.

listings.name: Essence of Lily
listings.blurb: A Cottesloe beauty therapy room covering facials, waxing and tinting, spray tanning and nails, with pregnancy massage on the treatment list as well.
listings._source: essenceoflily.com.au — Cottesloe location and the facial, waxing, tinting, spray tan, manicure, pedicure and pregnancy massage list confirmed from its own site. Street address and phone not captured; left empty pending one manual check.
